guide.samogon.title: Distiller's Guide
guide.samogon.body: Chain: malt -> wort -> fermentation -> wash -> pot still -> heads/hearts/tails -> reflux column -> filter -> dilution basin -> blend -> aging. The blending table has five slots: berries, honey, beetroot, potato, seeds, herbs, mushrooms and more. Empty-hand right-click opens the machine interface; right-click with an item is the quick manual path. Golden sparkles mean the product is ready. The thermometer and hydrometer report process values. This is a game simulation, not a real production guide.

guide.samogon.page.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
guide.samogon.page.trouble.heat: The tun does not heat: fire or a lit campfire must be directly below it.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.ferment: Fermentation stalled: keep 8-38 C. A campfire warms; ice cools.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.still: The still is silent: wash 100+, heat below, water bucket in the condenser.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.cuts: The still puked: lower the heat, refill coolant, and keep the cuts apart.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.column: The column is weak: feed low wines and heat below; a sieve gives 99.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.basin: The basin rejects it: spirit must be above 40%%; final volume up to 4000.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.bottle: Cannot bottle: bottle in output. Glow and sparkles mean ready.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.tip: Empty hand: panel. Shift+right-click: quick action. Meters: values.

guide.samogon.page.mash.title: Wash
guide.samogon.page.mash.step1: Malt into the tun, heat below. 20 sec.
guide.samogon.page.mash.step2: Bottle the wort, then add yeast.
guide.samogon.page.mash.step3: 5 min at 20 °C. Bottle the finished wash.
guide.samogon.page.mash.tip: 8–38 °C is the working range. Heat or cold stalls fermentation.
guide.samogon.page.mash.note: Progress stuck? Check the heat under the tun and the air around the barrel.
guide.samogon.page.still.title: Distilling
guide.samogon.page.still.bar.caption: the cuts come in order
guide.samogon.page.still.step1: Wash into the pot; water in the condenser is required.
guide.samogon.page.still.step3: Change the receiver with the interface button or Shift-right-click.
guide.samogon.page.still.step4: Hearts into a bottle. Heads and tails are technical.
guide.samogon.page.still.note: Light and sparkles mean ready. Do not clear the pot before the cuts are bottled.
guide.samogon.page.clean.title: Cleaning
guide.samogon.page.clean.step1: Any spirit into the column, heat below; choose 1–6 passes.
guide.samogon.page.clean.step2: Strength climbs: 62 → 76 → 85 → 90 → 94 → 96%%. A sieve from the 4th pass reaches 99.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.clean.step3: Spirit and charcoal into the filter.
guide.samogon.page.clean.step4: 30 sec. Check the strength with a hydrometer.
guide.samogon.page.clean.tip: The column takes about 60 sec per pass. Without a sieve it cannot pass 96%%; the sieve works from the 4th pass.
guide.samogon.page.dilute.title: Dilution
guide.samogon.page.dilute.gauge.caption: target 40%% ABV
guide.samogon.page.dilute.step2: A water bucket starts 10 sec of mixing.
guide.samogon.page.dilute.step4: Bottle it for blending or the cask. The basin holds up to 4000 units.
guide.samogon.page.dilute.tip: Hearts or clean spirit only. Never dilute heads and tails.
guide.samogon.page.blend.title: Blending
guide.samogon.page.blend.tag: five additives | up to five effects
guide.samogon.page.blend.ingredients: berries | honey | flowers | herbs | seeds | fruit | spice | seaweed
guide.samogon.page.blend.step2: Fill up to five slots: berries, honey, flowers, herbs, fruit, spice, mushrooms, seaweed and more.
guide.samogon.page.blend.step3: Press "Blend" or Shift+right-click with an empty hand.
guide.samogon.page.blend.tip: Repeating an additive strengthens its effect: five berries give berry V. Mixed additives give up to five level-I effects. Rectified spirit + botanical bundle = gin; add ferns for absinthe; sugar + berries or honey at 40%% = liqueur. Above 60%%: dilute in the basin.

guide.samogon.page.age.tip: Hearts or blend only, never heads and tails.

guide.samogon.brewer.page.mash.title: Mash
guide.samogon.brewer.page.mash.step1: Put malt, wheat or roasted malt into the raw slot.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.mash.step2: Pour the water: a water bucket into the additive slot.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.mash.step3: The mash runs 20 seconds; no fire is needed for the mash.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.mash.tip: The finished wort stays in the kettle or is bottled.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.mash.note: An empty bottle in the output slot is filled with the current stage.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.boil.title: Boil
guide.samogon.brewer.page.boil.step1: The kettle must already hold wort from the mash.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.boil.step2: Put hops into the additive slot.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.boil.step3: Light a fire directly below the brewery: the boil runs 30 seconds.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.boil.tip: Without fire below the kettle the boil is paused.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.boil.note: Boiling with hops raises the quality of the wort.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.ferment.title: Ferment
8–38 °C; below 14 °C a lager, above an ale
guide.samogon.brewer.page.ferment.step1: Drain the hopped wort from the brewery into the beer fermentation barrel.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.ferment.step2: Put yeast into the additive slot; honey, berries, an apple, hops or cocoa beans in the raw slot set the style.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.ferment.step3: Fermentation runs 3 min 20 sec and gives beer of about 5 %% ABV in a wooden mug.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.ferment.tip: Outside 8–38 °C fermentation stalls; heat and cold hurt quality. Cold below 14 °C gives a lager.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.bottle.title: Bottling
guide.samogon.brewer.page.bottle.step1: Place an empty wooden mug in the output slot for beer, and a glass bottle for wort.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.bottle.step2: The brewery fills a bottle with wort, the beer barrel fills a mug with beer.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.bottle.step3: Take the vessels while the machine still holds a drink.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.bottle.tip: Beer is poured only into wooden mugs; wort goes into glass bottles.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.heat: The kettle does not boil: fire or a lit campfire must be directly below the brewery.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.mash: The mash will not start: the raw slot needs malt, wheat or roasted malt, the additive slot a water bucket.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.boil: The boil is silent: the kettle needs finished wort, plus hops and fire below.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.fermen: Fermentation stalled: the beer barrel needs hopped wort and yeast, kept at 8–38 °C.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.bottle: The mug is not filled: beer needs one wooden mug in the output, wort a glass bottle.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.room: The brewery is not built: clear a 2×2 area.
guide.samogon.brewer.page.trouble.tip: Empty-hand right-click opens the panel. Light and sparkles mean ready.
